clusters.pick_reason: PR #2410 makes a minimal, general fix — widening the errlog type to `TextIO | int` — that lets any caller pass `subprocess.DEVNULL` or another FD without adding environment-detection logic to the library. PR #2020's `_is_jupyter_environment()` heuristic adds ~30 lines of IPython-specific detection that ties the library to a particular runtime, introduces an IPython import side-effect, and can false-positive or miss future Jupyter variants; the type-widening approach in #2410 delegates the decision to the caller and handles the same set of cases with a smaller diff and no new runtime dependencies.
